title: Report the ready and the whole cohort
statement: When learners arrive with gaps a course doesn't own, report outcomes both for the cohort without those gaps and for the whole cohort, never only one.
detail: A grade 7 and 8 prealgebra design, facing learners' debt in earlier-grade prerequisites and fluency, leads with a diagnostic map of that debt and always reports two numbers: outcomes for the native cohort and for the full cohort (`grade3-reading/ti-courseplans/courses/g7g8-prealgebra/brainlifts/v0.1.md`, line 26). Quoting only the native cohort is cherry-picking, and quoting only the full cohort punishes the course for earlier-grade debt it doesn't own.

evidence.quote: reports two numbers always: native-cohort outcomes and full-cohort outcomes. A course that only quotes the native cohort is cherry-picking; one that only quotes the full cohort punishes itself for K–6 debt it doesn't own.
The course leads with the diagnostic/debt map
